source_text: Ministratio mortis in litteris gloriosa fuit; ministratio Spiritus abundat gloria. Lege cum velamine remota. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Ministry of-death in letters glorious was; ministry of-Spirit abounds with-glory. Read with veil removed. Amen.
pass_b_english: The [[ministry of death in letters was glorious; the ministry of the Spirit abounds in glory >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:7-8]]. Read with the veil removed. Amen.
